intent.name: Todos
audience: one person keeping their own list
summary: A list of things you mean to do.
It exists so nothing you meant to do gets forgotten.
You add a thing, tick it when it is done, and delete it when it no longer matters.
success: Nothing you add is lost, and you can see at a glance what is done

concepts.purpose: You keep a list of things to do and tick them off
